purpose: Starting rules for what happens to a person's benefits when one of their positions ends while they keep another (docs/20 §6.2), and when their employment ends (docs/26 §7.1). They are examples, not advice: each organization edits, removes or adds rules to match its plan contracts, agreements and policies, and anything no rule covers goes to HR case by case (FB-021). When employment ends, the setup wizard asks each organization, for each class, when coverage ends: on the termination date, at the end of that month, or at the end of the notice or severance period; CanDo gives no starting answer. The statutory floor (rules/employment-standards benefits_during_notice) always applies on top.

match_fields.planKinds: Plan kinds such as health, dental, life, ltd
match_fields.scopes: Plan eligibility scopes: employer, agreement, assignment
match_fields.jurisdictions: Province or FED of the ending position
match_fields.employmentTypes: Employment type categories of the ending position (permanent, term, casual and the others), for rules by class (docs/26 §7.1)
match_fields.employmentContinues: true when the person keeps at least one position with the employer; false when employment ends

evaluation: Rules are tried in priority order (lowest first, then id); the first that matches decides. Eligibility on the remaining positions is checked first: if the person is still eligible, nothing changes. end_of_severance needs the weeks of severance the person receives; without them the proposal stops with INPUT_REQUIRED.
